note: Graham County Fair Association grounds on the south side of Hill City, by the rodeo arena near the Solomon River; electric (several 50-amp) and water hookups on poles scattered around a grassy field, unnumbered, bath house in the warm months. $10/night on the honor system per the chamber listing (seen 2024-2025), paid in a drop box at the southwest corner; a June 2026 camper reported $15.
